remarks: Bright second-floor apartment (stairs) with hardwood floors featuring an open living and kitchen area with good natural light. A Juliet balcony offers seasonal views of the river. The main level includes a bedroom with an en suite bath, a second bedroom, and a full hall bathroom.  Upstairs, the third level provides a private primary suite along with a separate office and additional storage space, creating a flexible layout for work or extended living. The unit includes parking for two cars and a dedicated washer and dryer located in a shared lower-level laundry area.  A prime space at an affordable price with all the amenities that Cos Cob has to offer: Schedule your tour today!
